scenario: Cancellation: a booked creator cancels a week before go-live and offers to pay the kill fee (Block 1)
subject: Re: Quillmoss x Amara - Barrier Reset booking confirmed

messages.body:
Hi Amara,

Lovely to have you on Barrier Reset. Here's the booking:

- Deliverable: 1 Instagram Reel, 950 USD (organic repost on our channels included)
- Draft for approval: by link, by Tuesday Oct 6
- Go-live: Saturday Oct 10
- Code: AMARA20 (20% off until Oct 11)
- PO number: PO-QM-26-0549

Your filming kit ships from Rotterdam this week, and the creator agreement is waiting for you in the Supplier Hub.

Speak soon,
Imogen
messages.subject: Quillmoss x Amara - Barrier Reset booking confirmed

messages.body:
Hi Imogen,

I'm really sorry to do this, but I have to cancel the Reel for the 10th. My mum is having surgery next week and I'm flying home to look after her for a few weeks, so I won't be able to film or post anything.

I went back through the agreement and saw the clause about a 50% kill fee once the brief is accepted - I completely understand if you need to invoice me for that, or take it some other way. Should I send the products back too?

Again, I'm so sorry for the short notice.

Amara
